911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

We are seeking a Principal Hardware Systems Architect to own system architecture and technical integration across electrical, RF, mechanical, thermal, and power domains.
Joining as a founding leader within the Axon 911 hardware team , you will define and drive the technical standards, architecture, and engineering processes that shape how our mission-critical hardware is designed, validated, and scaled to mass production.
You will partner closely with Electrical Engineering (EE), Radio Frequency (RF) Engineering, Software (SW) Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering (ME) leads to define system requirements, drive cross-functional design decisions, and ensure each subsystem comes together as a cohesive, production-ready device. When technical constraints compete, from antenna performance and enclosure design to thermal budgets and power delivery, you will be responsible for driving the system-level decision.

System Architecture & Design
Develop system architecture with consideration for industrial design, electrical design, radio frequency integration, mechanical design, software, and product management.
Build system architectures, block diagrams, and interaction diagrams to guide implementation.
Analyze power, thermal, and computational budget constraints, and develop solutions that balance performance, size, and cost.
Lead concept studies with internal and external development teams and present outcomes and recommendations.

Write and vet system requirements with clear, testable design targets for engineering and test teams.
Review and provide input on product requirements for next-generation devices.

s.h: Simulate and estimate subsystem capability against requirements.
s.t:
Manage requirements and maintain traceability from PRD through V&V.
Technical Leadership
Lead cross-discipline design reviews and organize cross-functional system reviews, building stakeholder buy-in.
Resolve competing engineering constraints and provide technical direction to EE, RF, and ME leads.
Design verification, validation planning & risk mitigation
Own the system-level verification and validation strategy, catching integration risks before certification and production.
Perform risk analysis, develop mitigation strategies, and close the loop on design characterization and verification results.
Carry technical accountability for program schedule and risk, translating complex engineering tradeoffs into clear decisions for program and executive leadership.
Manufacturing & Certification
Partner with ODM/JDM and manufacturing teams on DFM/DFA, engineering builds, and production readiness.
Own the system-level certification strategy across U.S. and international regulatory standards.

10+ years of hardware engineering experience , with deep expertise in at least two of electrical engineering, RF engineering, or mechanical engineering and strong working knowledge of the third.
Proven experience owning system architecture and cross-disciplinary technical decisions for complex, integrated hardware, including the judgment to resolve competing engineering constraints.
Track record of taking compact, connected, battery-powered hardware from concept through mass production , including EVT/DVT/PVT, certification, and manufacturing ramp.
Deep experience across RF/antenna integration, power architecture, thermal management, EMI/EMC, shielding, enclosure design, and mechanical tolerances .
Experience developing system requirements and validation plans , with familiarity across U.S. and international hardware certification and regulatory requirements.
Experience working with ODM/JDM or contract manufacturing partners through development and production.
Familiarity with relevant hardware design, simulation, testing, and lifecycle tools , such as Altium/Cadence, SolidWorks/Creo/NX, RF and electrical test equipment, thermal characterization tools, and PLM/BOM or requirements-management systems.
Strong ability to communicate technical risk to senior leadership and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while helping establish the standards and processes needed to scale.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Braze is making AI the default way of working across the company. Our Applied AI Architects are forward-deployed practitioners who combine domain judgment with hands-on build capability: they embed with business teams, treat employees as users and workflows as product surfaces, and ship working agents on shared infrastructure.

The function runs in two tracks.

GTM Architects are permanently embedded in the GTM organization, each owning a portion of a customer and prospect lifecycle that spans Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support; when they address friction in one stage, they work the surrounding levers holistically, mapping how those functions connect today and how AI could connect them better.

G&A Architects rotate across corporate functions like Finance, People, Legal, and Operations, driving each cohort to self-sufficiency.
You will lead this team. That means defining how a new role category operates, owning the portfolio of engagements across the business, and answering for the outcomes: adoption that persists, workflows that measurably improve, and committed bets that read out in business metrics like sales ramp time, quota capacity, and competitive win rate.
This is a player-coach role. You will carry enough build and field surface yourself to keep your judgment current, while your primary output is the team: who they are, where they embed, what they ship, and whether it works.

You inherit the hiring manager seat for all Architect roles, a unified interview loop, and an operating model with real momentum. What the function becomes from there is yours to shape, in close partnership with our Director of Applied AI Product, the CIO and CTO organizations, and the leaders of the functions your team serves.

Build the team. Close the open Architect reqs across both tracks (GTM and G&A), then own onboarding, development, and performance for a team of senior, highly autonomous ICs operating in a role category that barely exists in the market. Define what good looks like and what the career path is.
Own the engagement portfolio. Decide where Architects embed, what they prioritize, and when they rotate or scale back. Balance permanent GTM surface ownership against rotational G&A engagements. Say no to good ideas so the team ships great ones.
Answer for the bets. Own delivery and measurement of the committed GTM bets (sales ramp time, quota capacity / customer-facing time, competitive win rate) and run the promotion pipeline for G&A candidate bets. Every bet pairs a business outcome with leading indicators; you keep both honest.
Run the operating discipline. Enforce the engagement lifecycle (discovery, prioritization, readout, design, build, deliver, monitor) and the cohort maturity model. Adoption is the bar: an ignored output is a bug, and your team operates what it ships until it is productized.
Stay hands-on. Review agent designs, specs, and output quality at the system level. Carry a build surface of your own. Your field and build credibility is what earns the team its seat in pipeline reviews and functional staff meetings.
Compound through the platform. Partner with the Director of Applied AI Product to move field-proven patterns into shared infrastructure, and to feed field reality back into platform requirements, evaluation criteria, and measurement frameworks.
Be the executive interface. Negotiate embed agreements with CRO and CBO leadership and functional executives, represent the function's results and roadmap to senior leadership, and protect your team's focus when demand outstrips capacity, which it will.
Write the playbook. The role category is being defined in real time across the industry. Document what works, publish it internally, and make Braze a reference point for how a scaled SaaS company runs applied AI.

A proven leader of senior technical ICs. You have built and led high-autonomy teams: forward-deployed engineering, solutions consulting or architecture, field engineering, or an applied AI/ML group. You know how to manage outcomes without hovering, and how to coach people more specialized than you.
A builder with current hands. You have personally built AI agents, automations, or LLM-powered tools that changed how real work gets done, and you can evaluate someone else's system design, retrieval logic, and output quality without an interpreter.
Credible in the field. You have spent real time in or alongside the commercial motion of a B2B SaaS company. You can sit in a pipeline review, an EBR, or a functional leadership meeting and have the room take you seriously.
A portfolio operator. You think in terms of impact, feasibility, and sequencing across many competing demands, and you can defend your prioritization to executives who wanted a different answer.
Fluent in measurement. You can design a baseline, argue a leading indicator, dollarize an efficiency gain, and tell the difference between a metric that proves a mechanism and one that flatters a narrative.
A zero-to-one leader. You have stood up a function, practice, or team where no playbook existed, and you are comfortable being accountable for results while the ground is still moving.

10+ years of professional experience spanning GTM-adjacent technical work (solutions consulting/architecture, field or forward-deployed engineering, technical GTM strategy) and hands-on building
3+ years leading senior individual contributors, with evidence you developed and retained them
Demonstrated, hands-on experience building AI-powered tools, agents, or workflows that transformed real work, with concrete examples you can speak to in depth
Track record of standing up a new team, practice, or function and scaling it past your own personal capacity
Executive-level communication and stakeholder management, including negotiating priorities with senior leaders
Experience defining and defending business-impact measurement for a technical team
You have led forward-deployed engineering or applied AI teams at a model lab, an AI-native company, or a scaled enterprise SaaS business

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
The customers you’ll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they’re trying to solve are real and urgent. You’ll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Global Partnerships org is building an ecosystem motion that genuinely multiplies CockroachDB's market reach — and the results are already showing.

In the past year alone, the team launched the ISV Technology Partner Program, shipped live integrations with LangChain, Anthropic Claude Code, Confluent, and Datadog, deepened a global IBM OEM relationship that reaches regulated enterprise accounts no direct sales team can access alone, and launched the CockroachDB Integrations Hub.

Our AWS Strategic Collaboration Agreement is evolving into a systematic AI ISV acquisition engine, with early traction from AI-native companies.
As Principal Solutions Architect for the Americas partner team, you'll be the technical authority across our Cloud, ISV, OEM, and GSI partner motions in the Americas — combining deep technical credibility with proactive strategic leadership. You'll own your domain end-to-end: identifying integration opportunities before they're requested, building and certifying assets, shaping GTM narratives, enabling partners, and driving real pipeline influence. This is a builder role — you set the agenda.
You Will
Formulate and execute technical partner strategy and GTM plans in close collaboration with your Business Development counterparts.
Develop and deliver a full content arsenal — executive GTM presentations, thought leadership white papers, technical blogs, joint customer case studies, webinars, and conference talks — as well as integration walkthrough videos, quickstart demos, and co-marketing launch packages executed hand-in-hand with partner marketing teams to turn technical integrations into measurable developer adoption and pipeline.
Act as the trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to Americas-based Cloud, ISV, OEM, and GSI partners during discovery and opportunity identification phase.
Lead architectural discussions, design exercises, and integration planning across all levels of partner and customer organizations, from developer teams to C-suite executives
Support POCs and technical validation for internal teams relating to partner solutions and cockroachDB.
Lead deep technical conversations with Internal and external stakeholders engineering - provide guidance on architecture, deployment patterns, migration strategies, and integration design while adapting technical depth and messaging to the audience and scenario
Build and publish reusable technical assets — validated architectures, integration SDKs, reference implementations, GitHub repos, and proof-of-concept applications — that the broader field and partner ecosystem can leverage; amplify each integration launch with co-marketing assets including integration quickstart guides, partner badge programs, and developer community presence on the platforms where builders actually spend their time
Use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT) as part of your daily workflow to compress reactive support work, generate content, automate reporting, and accelerate asset creation
The Expectations
In your first 30 days , you will learn about CockroachDB and become proficient in the product and our AI-native tooling stack. You will onboard the Americas partner landscape, meet key BDs and partners, and understand the active pipeline and strategic priorities for the region.
By the end of your first 90 days , you will have effectively onboarded onto Americas regional coverage, shipped 1+ reusable technical assets (repo, validated architecture, or demo), integrated AI tools into your daily workflow, and received positive BD feedback on your technical leadership in partner conversations.

You should have your first ecosystem integration contribution scoped or in progress, and be operating with structured autonomy — owning your priorities, coming with plans, and shipping weekly.
You Have
10+ years in pre-sales, solutions architecture, partner engineering, or technical consulting roles within the cloud technology space
A visible body of published technical work and GTM content — repos, white papers, blogs, validated architectures, reference implementations, presentation decks, and thought leadership materials — that establishes your credibility in the field
Comfort speaking in front of groups for presentations, webinars, talks, both internally and externally
Deep understanding of cloud ecosystems, with hands-on experience in at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure — their architecture paradigms, partnership programs, marketplace mechanics, and co-sell motions
Strong hands-on technical skills — you can build demos, write code, design architectures, and run POCs. You are not purely a slide-and-talk SA
Experience with relational databases, distributed systems, and/or SQL — knowledge of PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, or distributed SQL is a strong plus
Demonstrated track record of presenting to and influencing diverse stakeholders — from hands-on architects and engineering leads to VPs, CTOs, and partner executive sponsors — with the technical credibility to command a room and the versatility to adapt narrative, depth, and delivery format to any audience
Proficiency with AI-assisted tools and workflows — you currently use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) in your work and see AI as an accelerator, not a novelty
Strong business acumen — you understand partner economics, marketplace dynamics, and how technical work connects to pipeline and revenue
Self-directed and initiative-driven — you identify priorities, create plans, and execute without waiting to be told what to do
Strong public speaking and presentation skills — you have presented at conferences, partner summits, executive briefings, or industry events and can point to a body of work (talks, webinars, blogs, video content, published writing) that demonstrates your technical credibility and thought leadership; you are comfortable on camera, capable of creating compelling recorded demos and integration walkthroughs, and you know how to build authentic developer presence on the platforms where technical audiences actually spend time
Ability to travel as needed for partner events, customer meetings, and conferences

What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.
Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.
How you’ll demonstrate Ownership
As Tech Lead/Architect for the Supply Chain CoE, you own the technical spine of Cognite's Integrated Supply Chain offering — knowledge graph, generative AI agents, and command-center UX.

You'll act as the subject-matter expert across source-make-deliver, modeling customers' supply chains and showing how AI/UI tools turn an integrated graph into deviation triage and resolution. You're equally comfortable in a C-level value conversation and a technical session on data models or agent skills.

The bar goes beyond prompting AI: you'll engineer domain expertise into testable, deterministic playbooks — treating CoE knowledge as a rigorous system with guardrails, ground-truth testing, and staged rollouts.
The Impact you bring to Cognite
Solution & CoE Strategy: Align the CoE on high-impact use cases (e.g., delayed inbound spare → maintenance delay → order risk) and deploy them as demos or customer solutions.
Knowledge-Graph Data Modeling: Lead customer modeling sessions; show how domain data models and complex hierarchies absorb requirements securely and at scale.
Data & AI Architecture: Guide customers on adopting our graph/AI/UI stack, including integration patterns (Snowflake, Databricks, ERPs) and why agents must be grounded in deterministic graph paths.
AI Skill-System Authorship: Turn domain expertise into structured AI skills with fixed parameters, guardrails, and testable anchors, keeping data models and agent logic aligned.
Agentic Tooling & QA: Serve as escalation point for complex graph queries and agent/UI design; own testing and evaluation frameworks, classifying failures rigorously before changing agent logic.
Enterprise Architecture & Value Selling: Support end-to-end architecture reviews and quantify commercial impact (orders at risk, delay penalties, landed costs) for executive business cases.
Partner Enablement & Documentation: Equip partners with reusable demos and accelerators; maintain clear, consistent terminology across models, docs, and AI logic.

Deep knowledge of industrial supply chain planning/execution and its links to production, quality, and maintenance; fluency with ISA-95/88 and SCOR frameworks.
5+ years in industrial supply chain (planning, logistics, inventory) and 5+ years in pre-sales, solution architecture, or delivery for enterprise software.
Experience designing industrial information/knowledge-graph data models (temporal relations, typed hierarchies) and integrating structured/unstructured enterprise data.
Hands-on proficiency in Python and frontend (TypeScript/React), with strong engineering discipline (ADRs, automated testing, CI/CD).
Systemic AI/testing mindset: optimized tool routing, rigorous multi-stage evaluation, root-cause debugging, and graceful handling of edge cases — not just prompting.
Excellent client-facing skills, able to translate complex data/AI concepts for audiences from engineers to C-level executives.
Familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark/SQL), source systems (ERP/MES/WMS/TMS), and agentic AI/LLM workflow design.
Prior experience in high-growth (startup/scale-up) environments; Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Own the architecture of the end-to-end trading platform: the sequencer, the low-latency connectivity and messaging fabric, OMS/EMS, multi-venue connectivity, and execution.
Design low-latency, high-throughput systems for real-time financial products used across institutional and retail markets.
Drive reliability and performance, owning SLOs, observability, and incident response for systems where correctness and latency are non-negotiable.
Set the technical bar through code, design reviews, and standards, and pay down the technical debt that matters most.
Reduce single-point-of-failure risk across the trading stack and build team resilience through mentorship.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Risk, Security, and Compliance to turn technical vision into a roadmap.

Hands-on architect, able to design, build, deploy, and support 24/7 trading systems that process billions of dollars of transactions daily.
Extensive backend engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, production-grade distributed systems.
Track record of architecting an end-to-end trading platform (OMS, front/middle office, multi-exchange connectivity), not just a single gateway.
Deep proficiency in low-latency Java and high-throughput messaging (Aeron, SBE, or similar), designing event-driven, high-availability systems.
Experience delivering projects end-to-end: scoping, architecture, implementation, monitoring, and iteration.
Experience building systems in a regulated or financial environment where correctness, auditability, and low-latency performance are critical.
Experience making user-facing product decisions that balance engineering trade-offs with end-user quality, demonstrated through shipped products.
Responsible use of generative AI, with human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Experience with data warehousing, ETL, data integration.

Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilising the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers.

You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role.

It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/ specialised teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon.

This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.

Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create, own and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
Enablement / user growth plan
Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
Executive and operational governance
Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM

10+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
Can travel up to 30% when needed

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey.

You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers.

You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability for our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage of Databricks workloads they have already selected, helping them maximize the value they get from our platform and their return on investment.
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role.

It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon.

This is in parallel to being technical, with the expectation that you will become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate effectively with an organization at all levels.

You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.

Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to the production/go-live status of agreed-upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical experts, to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create, own, and execute a point of view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews, and upgrade needs
Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the following work streams:
Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
Enablement/user growth plan
Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
Executive and operational governance
Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM

5+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project/program delivery within the domain of Data and AI, and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
Programming experience in Python, SQL, or Scala
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
Understanding of solution architecture related to distributed data systems
Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
Technical program, or project management, including account, stakeholder, and resource management accountability
Experience in resolving complex and important escalations with senior customer executives
Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis, and managing the delivery of complex programs/projects
Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
Ability to travel up to 30% when needed

Solution Architect, APAC
Welcome to Fireblocks, the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions!

As of January 2026 we serve over 2,400 institutional customers, have secured over $10 trillion in digital asset transfers, and are the world’s highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised.
Our mission is simple: enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale

s.h: Here’s the bit about the opportunity
s.t: As a Solution Architect in our APAC Professional Services team, you own the technical delivery of Fireblocks implementations for the region’s largest Banks and Financial Institutions. From deal close through to production, you lead architecture design, integration, and deployment on customer infrastructure. You also bring that delivery expertise into strategic pre-sales cycles, helping Sales win the deals you will go on to deliver.

Owning the transition from deal close to production, taking end-to-end accountability for the solutions delivered
Defining enterprise customers’ setup with Fireblocks, including API integrations, security architecture, and architecture documentation
Steering complex integrations across core banking, custody, tokenisation, and Travel Rule through to production
Codifying reusable reference architectures, integration patterns, and playbooks to scale delivery across APAC
Acting as the bridge between Sales, Product, R&D, and customers to solve complex integration challenges
Supporting strategic pre-sales cycles with technical discovery and solution design
Ensuring operational excellence and a high standard of customer satisfaction throughout delivery

Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or a related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience
Proven experience delivering post-sale implementations in complex enterprise or financial services environments
Experience with either blockchain, cryptography, or Web3 technologies, or with Banks, Financial Institutions, or enterprise financial systems. One is a must, both is a strong advantage
Software development experience and a hands-on technical mindset
Deep understanding of IT security and proven cloud experience
Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture and best practices
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring engineers or architects and setting technical standards
Pre-sales exposure (solution architecture, sales engineering, or RFP support) is a plus
Excellent written and spoken English; additional APAC languages are a plus

As Expert HR Tech Solution Architect , you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix’s global HR technology landscape.
Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization — ensuring our technology enables Flix’s future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally.
You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team — including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts — builds within.
This role is based in Berlin, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.

Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems — ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements.
Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations — evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization.
Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems — determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures.
Establish and evolve HR technology governance and control frameworks, including system ownership and RACI, security and role-model design, least privilege and segregation of duties, audit trails, change/release governance, internal controls and data privacy aligned with GDPR and audit/IPO-readiness expectations.
Act as the bridge between HR functional and technology teams, translating business and process requirements into target-state solutions and executable designs, and driving global HR technology implementation projects from requirements through go-live.

8+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, HRIS, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or HRIS delivery, with a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field.
Strong HR domain and HR technology expertise, with an understanding of how core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting and surrounding enterprise systems work together across a global HR technology landscape.
Demonstrable experience driving HRIS transformations, including major HRIS redesigns, platform revamps and/or migrations end to end. Hands-on enterprise HRIS experience across configuration, integration or migration is a strong differentiator.
Strong integration and systems architecture knowledge, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, data flows and event-driven architectures across complex enterprise environments.
Experience supporting the design of HR target operating models, HR service-delivery models and technology governance frameworks, including security and role models, segregation of duties, audit trails, internal controls and data privacy in regulated, multi-country environments.
Experience with cloud architecture and AI & automation technologies is critical, including areas such as Claude/GenAI deployment, MCPs, n8n and Rovo Agents, alongside strong Jira project-management capabilities.
Fluency in English. Certifications in solution/enterprise architecture, project management, agile or automation (e.g. TOGAF, PMP, SAFe, Scrum, Six Sigma, n8n) are a plus.
We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

As a Professional Services Technical Architect at GitLab, you'll lead the technical direction of customer engagements from early scoping and discovery through delivery.

You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW).

You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate.

You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes.

This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.

Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices.
Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate.
Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices.
Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.
Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.
Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.
Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.
Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.
Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.
Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.
Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.
Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.
Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.
Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations.
Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies.
Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.
UK remote based role.
Up to 50% travel at times.
Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.
Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.

Location: This position is remote within Colombia.
About Technology.
Technology at Huge is powered by a global practice of creative technologists—spanning Engineers, QA specialists, Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and ML Architects—we look beyond standard patterns to build resilient, enterprise-grade systems.

We combine deep engineering rigor with innovation at the edge of agentic AI, modern data stacks, and cloud infrastructure. We don't wait for industry standards to set themselves; we engineer the intelligent systems that turn audacious strategic vision into production-ready reality.

Huge is looking for a Solutions Architect to join the Technology Craft in Colombia. In this role, you will provide technical guidance throughout the application development lifecycle with a strong modern full-stack experience.

In this internal, technical role, you will focus on solution architecture and integration design, defining the application structure and integration strategy with backend services, and evaluating front-end stack feasibility.

You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to translate technical requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions and deliver key technical documentation and roadmaps.
What you'll be doing.
Advise on overall application structure, full-stack architecture, and technical approaches while assessing front-end stack feasibility.
Define and guide the integration strategy between front-end components, backend services, APIs, and healthcare data standards (FHIR R4), incorporating secure identity and authentication approaches.
Architect composable platforms leveraging SaaS CMS, 3rd-party DAMs, API mesh/APIM orchestration, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hosting solutions with Caching, HA, and DR capabilities.
Support technical audits, author inputs for the Technical Design Document (TDD), formalize decisions using an Architectural Decision Record (ADR) process, and detail execution roadmaps for subsequent development phases.
Oversee monorepo strategies, spec-driven development integration, CI/CD pipelines, quality checks, branching methodologies, and HIPAA-compliant architecture patterns.
Partner closely with engineering teams to resolve challenges, ensure full-stack alignment, and drive scope ramp-up for seamless roadmap handoffs.
What we'd like to see.
Proven experience architecting composable platforms, integrating SaaS-based CMS solutions (e.g., Optimizely, Contentstack, Contentful), and integrating 3rd-party Digital Asset Managers (DAMs).

About MongoDB
MongoDB는 변화를 위해 만들어졌습니다. 우리는 고객과 구성원들이 시장의 속도에 맞춰 혁신할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 우리는 AI 시대를 위한 데이터 플랫폼을 새롭게 정의함으로써, 빌더들이 소프트웨어를 통해 산업을 창조하고, 변화시키며, 혁신할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다. 시장에서 가장 폭넓게 제공되며 전 세계에 분산된 MongoDB의 통합 데이터 플랫폼은 조직이 레거시 워크로드를 현대화하고, 혁신을 수용하며, AI의 잠재력을 최대한 발휘할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 클라우드 네이티브 플랫폼인 MongoDB Atlas는 전 세계에 분산된 유일한 멀티클라우드 데이터 플랫폼으로, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure 전반에서 사용할 수 있습니다.
전 세계에 오피스를 두고 있는 MongoDB는 67,000개 이상의 고객을 보유하고 있으며, 여기에는 포춘 100대 기업의 75%와 AI 네이티브 스타트업이 포함됩니다. 이들은 가장 중요한 애플리케이션을 MongoDB로 운영하고 있으며, 우리는 소프트웨어의 다음 시대를 이끌고 있습니다.
MongoDB에서 우리의 나침반은 Leadership Commitment 입니다. 이는 우리가 어떻게, 그리고 왜 의사결정을 내리는지, 서로를 위해 어떻게 행동하는지, 그리고 어떻게 함께 성공하는지를 이끄는 기준입니다. 이것이 바로 MongoDB를 MongoDB답게 만드는 요소입니다.
우리는 모든 구성원의 개인적 성장과 비즈니스 영향력을 높이기 위해, 모든 사람에게 지지와 풍요로움을 제공하는 문화를 만드는 데 헌신하고 있습니다. 직원 커뮤니티(affinity groups)에서부터 난임 치료 지원, 그리고 넉넉한 부모 휴가 제도 에 이르기까지, 우리는 구성원의 웰빙을 중요하게 여기며, 그들의 직업적·개인적 여정을 모든 단계에서 지원합니다. MongoDB에서 일하는 것이 어떤 경험인지 더 알아보고, 세상에 변화를 만드는 우리의 여정에 함께해 주세요!

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

The future of Go-To-Market systems at Samsara is agentic, intelligent, and automated — and you will define what that future looks like. As Lead AI Architect, GTM Systems, you will set the technical vision for how Samsara's GTM technology organization builds AI-powered automation: from low-code platforms that put power in the hands of operators, to custom agentic pipelines that tackle the most complex GTM workflows.
This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide scope. You won't just advise — you'll architect, prototype, and establish the patterns that the entire GTM engineering team builds against. You'll be the person who defines when to reach for a low-code tool like Workato or Salesforce Flow, when to build a custom LangGraph agent, and how to connect them into a coherent, governed, enterprise-grade system.
You will partner with GTM engineering leadership, Sales Ops, BizTech, and C-level business stakeholders to translate strategic ambitions into architectural blueprints — and then make sure those blueprints become reality. You'll shape the standards, reference architectures, and evaluation frameworks that ensure Samsara's GTM systems are built to last.
This is a remote role open to candidates in Canada.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

You believe the most durable AI systems are the ones designed for human oversight, transparent reasoning, and safe, auditable operation

Own the integration architecture strategy across the GTM systems landscape — defining the patterns, APIs, event contracts, and data models that allow GTM systems to evolve independently while staying reliably connected
Champion a scalable low-code-first strategy: define the governance model, extensibility patterns, and operational standards that allow non-engineers to build automations safely without creating fragility or compliance risk
Partner with VP-level GTM stakeholders to translate strategic business goals into concrete architectural roadmaps — with clear trade-offs, timelines, and success criteria

Produce internal thought leadership — white papers, architecture decision records (ADRs), and engineering wikis — that raise the collective technical bar across the GTM systems organization

Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!
This role is hybrid requiring 2 days in office at our San Francisco hub every Tuesday & Wednesday (located at 130 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA).

The Architecture Team drives Taskrabbit's Platform Modernization efforts, guiding engineering teams toward our Target State Architecture (TSA). As a Staff Software Architect, you'll serve as an embedded representative of the Architecture team, partnering with engineering teams across the platform to accelerate their modernization work.
You'll operate as a subject matter expert on platform modernization within a small team of architects, applying AI-assisted and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) practices to help teams build new components using our Target State Architecture stack of technologies. This role is hands-on and results-oriented: pairing directly with engineers and technical leads, not just advising from the sidelines.

Acting as the Architecture team's representative to assigned engineering teams, driving platform modernization projects in accordance with the TSA.
Applying AI tooling and Spec-Driven Development practices to help teams modernize the parts of the platform they own.
Pairing with engineers and technical leadership to unblock modernization work and transfer architectural patterns directly into team practice.
Serving as a subject matter expert on platform modernization, advising on migration approach, sequencing, and risk.
Advocating for TSA-aligned solutions in technical discussions, including working through design discussions with engineering leads and other stakeholders.
Collaborating with a small team of architects to maintain consistency across modernization efforts platform-wide.
Writing and reviewing Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and RFCs, and coaching authors to strengthen their proposals.
Defining standards for tooling, coding, processes, AI usage, and documentation strategies that make modernization repeatable across teams.
This is not a purely consultative role. You're expected to engage directly with projects and drive results forward — TDDs, code, and outcomes.

8+ years of professional experience in software development, with a primary focus on building and scaling backend systems.
Demonstrated experience with distributed systems and event-driven architecture.
TypeScript/Node.js experience preferred; candidates with a background in another strongly typed language (e.g., Java, .NET) will also be considered.
Experience with containerization and containerized application deployment.

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Architect, Enterprise AI (L6)

This position is needed to define and drive the vision, software architecture, and establish the AI/ML platforms across all of our business functions internally at Twilio.
Our charter and remit has expanded to cover all of the business teams companywide, including Marketing, Sales, Customer Support & Global Operations, along with our corporate functions, including HR/People, Finance, Legal, Security & Privacy. This position sits within Nebius Token Factory, our serverless platform for running and customizing open-source LLMs in production. Token Factory allows for serverless inference and fine-tuning backed by in-house optimizations like custom speculative decoding, quantization, cache-aware routing and dedicated endpoints. Customers come to us to move from prototype to scaled production without the cost and complexity of building and tuning their own inference stack.
Our Solutions Architects own the technical delivery of customer engagements: deploying open-source models, tuning the serving stack, benchmarking against the customer's success criteria, and carrying the technical relationship through to production. Sales Engineers qualify and scope the opportunity; SAs execute it. Technical Account Managers take it from production onward.
We're looking for a Manager, ML Solutions Architecture to lead our EU regional SA teams. Your scope is PoC delivery and post-sales technical support : the people who do it, the standard they do it to, and the operating cadence that keeps it predictable. You will report to the Head of Solutions Architecture and partner with a peer manager in the other region.
We expect you to push people when they need pushing, make the uncomfortable call when deliverables don't land even though the effort was real, and take ownership of the documentation work: implement and monitor the following of the guidelines, ticket hygiene, and making sure the team actually uses all three.
You're welcome to work remotely from any EU country.

Manage a team of 8 Solutions Architects, with continued growth planned: 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, promotion cases, and individual growth plans
Build an accurate picture of each SA's strengths, gaps, and preferences, and allocate accounts and engagements against both expertise and interest
Run the cadence that surfaces blockers early, then take them to the development, product, and business teams that can clear them, and stay on them until they do
Hold people to outcomes: distinguish effort from delivered results, say so plainly when the two diverge, and reflect it in ratings and compensation decisions
Onboard new joiners through to their first independently delivered engagement
Coach SAs into stronger engineers and stronger communicators, and make deliberate calls about who is ready for more scope
Own delivery
Be accountable for your team's delivery outcomes: time from PoC kick-off to first optimized dedicated endpoint, success-criteria hit rate, and the quality of the technical relationship after the customer goes to production
Review technical work before it reaches the customer: benchmarking methodology, serving configurations, results, closure documents; catch the wrong conclusion drawn from a metrics artifact before a customer sees it
Ensure staffing and escalation coverage across accounts and timezones, including post-sales request load that does not respect sprint boundaries
Call infeasibility early and with evidence, rather than letting the team burn iterations against requirements the platform cannot meet today

s.h: Own the operating system of the team
s.t:
Maintain and extend the team's documentation: responsibilities, runbooks, guides, onboarding, definitions of done, engagement closure templates. Keep it accurate and reachable; link, don't copy
Get it used , not just written: documentation nobody reads is a cost, not an asset
Keep the ticket tracker the system of record, so PoC and production status is readable without asking anyone
Instrument the work: define and report the metrics that show whether delivery is getting faster and more reliable over time
Work across teams
Development and research teams: convert recurring customer pain into prioritized platform work, and represent the customer's technical reality in roadmap discussions
Pre-sales: hold the scoping-to-execution boundary: push back on under-scoped engagements, and feed feasibility signal back upstream
Account management: make production handoffs uneventful, and keep post-sales technical requests moving
Business and leadership: give a straight read on account health, technical feasibility, and capacity needs

3+ years managing technical teams, including performance management and difficult conversations
Experience managing a customer-facing team. Running a team whose work is visible to customers, on customer timelines, with customer escalations.
Strong ML knowledge: LLM architectures, fine-tuning approaches (SFT/LoRA, RL-based), evaluation design, and a working command of inference internals — quantization, KV-cache management, batching, routing, speculative decoding — and of the frameworks the team works in (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM)
Enough technical judgment to review someone else's benchmark and find the flaw in the methodology, not just in the conclusion
Python strong enough to read and review your team's code
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to diverse audiences, from engineers to executives, including in front of enterprise customers under pressure
Genuine tolerance for operational work: documentation, process design, reporting, and the follow-through that makes them stick
Comfort operating with ambiguity across distributed teams and timezones, and a bias toward writing things down

s.h: It would be an added bonus if you have
s.t:
References from both former managers and former direct reports
Experience scaling a team through rapid growth (5 → 15+) without losing delivery quality
Prior experience in a customer-facing technical function at a cloud, inference, or AI infrastructure provider
Experience defining process and documentation for a team that had none
Hands-on background running LLMs in production and debugging inference workloads at the framework level
Work with multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech)
Proficiency with DevOps tooling (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code

Programming languages: Python
ML frameworks and libraries: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Transformers, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs
MLOps and DevOps tools: Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Git
Cloud platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), GCP (Vertex AI), Azure (Azure ML)

As a Solutions Architect, Enterprise, you will be the technical lead for a portfolio of large customers evaluating, adopting and expanding Nebius AI Cloud. You will connect each customer's AI strategy and business priorities to a secure, scalable architecture, then guide the customer from technical discovery through technical scoping and production adoption.
This role sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, AI infrastructure and business value. You will work with Enterprise sales leaders and engage executives, platform teams, infrastructure leaders, security stakeholders and AI or machine learning practitioners. The strongest candidates combine hands-on technical depth with the judgment to navigate complex decisions of large organizations in real economic sectors.
You’re welcome to work remotely from the USA.

Serve as the trusted technical advisor for Enterprise accounts throughout evaluation, onboarding, adoption and expansion.

Excellent presentation, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, including confidence with CIOs, CTOs, infrastructure leaders, AI leaders and business sponsors.
Strong knowledge and hands on experience with cloud-native infrastructure, including compute and orchestration, storage, networking, security, identity and Kubernetes.

You will be the architecture owner for Experian's global video conferencing estate and collaboration spaces, driving standardization and lifecycle governance across 400+ video conferencing units and our global refresh roadmap. Architect and govern the refresh program, in consideration of the located budget.

The program executes prioritization based on site strategy (Grow/Maintain/Retire), technology lifecycle status (including TLMP-driven replacements), and room usage/telemetry. This prioritization focuses investment on high-value rooms.

You will lead room standards, VC platforms/devices, monitoring/telemetry, lifecycle/refresh execution architecture, and site readiness planning w/ local facilities teams. You will report to a Senior Director.

Build global VC/Rooms architecture & standards: Define room typologies, standard bills of material, supported device classes (including standardization toward MTR patterns), configuration baselines, and supportability guardrails.
FY27 lifecycle refresh governance (budget-aligned): Architect the FY27 refresh plan using lifecycle/usage/site strategy and manage quarterly prioritization and rebalancing in consideration of the budget allocation and quarterly budget phasing.
EoL/risk management for decommissioned devices: Improve remediation for restricted-state/EoL devices (e.g., impacted Cisco models listed as decommissioned/restricted) and ensure sequencing reduces user impact and operational risk.
"Replace on failure" and non-planned remediation architecture: Define technical standards and governance for emergency replacements and quality enhancements due to unexpected site changes, room remodels, device/peripheral failures, or accessory requirements.
Monitor & proactive operations enablement: Expand monitoring approaches and define quality/performance telemetry standards to address support gaps and reduce escalations.
Network and SD‑WAN dependency management (room readiness): Architect readiness and validation patterns for network changes that impact VC rooms (e.g., SD‑WAN upgrades requiring on‑site testing of all units; dynamic implementation dates; site testing quantities and readiness discipline).
Facilities/site leader engagement: Partner with Facilities leads to confirm competing plans, validate site strategy, and ensure refresh deployments align to workplace changes and constraints.
Vendor technical leadership and platform transition planning: Lead technical evaluation across VC ecosystems (including Webex upgrades/major platform changes and onboarding automation where applicable) and ensure alignment to global standards and support models.
10–15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise video conferencing / AV / collaboration spaces architecture, including global standardization and refresh programs.
Track record managing lifecycle transitions and EoL/EoS remediation across a large VC estate, using telemetry/usage insights to prioritize investments.
Delivery leadership—comfortable operating at the intersection of Workplace/Facilities, Network, and UC Engineering/Operations to deliver room readiness and user experience.
